description: Add information to an escalation case you opened: for example what you decided, a reply from your principal, who your principal is and how to reach them, or anything our team asked you for. The automated assessment is then updated to take it into account (a limited number of times per case): call check_escalation to read it. Needs the case_id and case_token from submit_escalation.

case_token.description: The case_token returned by submit_escalation. Keep it private.

message.description: What to add (up to 4,000 characters, plain English).

nonce.description: Optional random string (8-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -). It is echoed inside the signed response so you can detect replays.

name: add_to_escalation
title: Add information to an escalation case
